final_claim: For finite normalized nondecreasing submodular f with all singleton w_e=f({e})>0, polymatroid independence polytope P_f has Minkowski asymmetry ρ=max_nonemptyS w(S)/f(S). The entire minimizing-center locus is (w+z)/(ρ+1) with z≥0 supported outside maximal density-tight union T and z(S)≤ρ(f(T∪S)−f(T))−w(S); its affine dimension is |E\T| and center unique exactly when E is density-tight.
limitations: No integrality/representability assumption, but finite E, normalized monotone submodular f and strictly positive singleton f({e}) needed.
Not arbitrary base polytopes, sections or models with loops.
